title: Single violation: one buy pushes a name past the concentration cap
notes: Equity 40000.00, cap 15% = 6000.00. No existing NFLX position, so the literal 10000.00 buy alone would make NFLX 10000/40000 = 25% of equity, breaching the cap -- R3 fires (disposition REPAIRED). R3's repair policy is uniform regardless of the original order's sizing mode: always resize DOWN to the largest whole-share qty that keeps the resulting position at or under the cap (matches case_003's precedent -- see CLAUDE.md's repair principle). NFLX @ 600.00/share, headroom 6000.00 -> floor(6000.00/600.00) = 10 shares = 6000.00 exactly (15.0% of equity, at but not over the cap; this headroom happens to divide evenly, unlike case_003's NVDA/AMD). No existing position, no open orders, no wash-sale history, market open, buying power (40000.00) covers even the original 10000.00 request so R1 never enters into it. Single rule fires.
